correctness.rationale: Checcoli–D’Adderio identity N(a,b)=b/[a(a-b+1)]*binom(a,b)^2 yields N(a,b) square iff ab(a-b+1) square. For b=c^2, it becomes y^2=a(a-b+1). Difference of squares (2a-d)^2-(2y)^2=d^2, d=b-1. Factoring gives all proper divisor pairs of h^2, with parity proving a(u) integral in both c parity classes. Monotonicity of u+h^2/u on u<h gives uniqueness and maxima; tau(h^2) gives counts; h prime only c=2,3 gives zero nontrivial cases. Pell units give infinite rows when b nonsquare. Independent exact-integer checks for c=2..12 match classifications, including {16,20,27,64} and {25,27,32,49}; finite checks do not justify full Pell branch.
